title: Daily cross-sectional stock selection harness, bounded diagnostics
question: Can a fixed LightGBM regression on daily ranks improve selection against frozen price-volume baselines, on identical causal walk-forward dates? Historical sample diagnostics only; no market-wide or deployable-alpha claim.

splits.scheme: expanding quarterly folds; train from 2021-01-01, validate common sessions of 2022 in chunks of 63; additive purge+embargo; baseline evaluated on identical validation days

period.pending: no final test in this PR; fixed window at future model freeze

test.exposure_audit: 2022 historical development diagnostics, not pristine sealed evidence; counted as one diagnostic look before fetch
test.seal_rule: no prospective metrics or verdict in this PR

candidate_policies.description: all 10 factors plus benchmark-relative versions; higher up except lower volatility; no selection by reported result
60 estimators,7 leaves,lr .05,min_child40,L2 1,seed1474,one thread; regression on daily percentile rank

costs_fills.cost_table: assumptions: KR25/US10/crypto15 bps per side; h-day spread minus 4 sides, independent vintages, no netting
fill_models: close-marked diagnostic only; no fill, short availability, capacity, or NAV claim

tuning_budget.search: none; no tuning, early stopping, fitted preprocessing or feature selection

metrics.primary: daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; diagnostic exception to NAV-based primary
family: 20 baselines and one ranker per market x 4 horizons

stopping_rules: any temporal leakage invalidates the run
no market-wide claim on explicit survivor samples
no scheduling, DB, account endpoints, or orders
no TFT or gate verdict in this PR
